faq.a1: Sebenza is a South African national talent platform. Job seekers create a professional profile once and can be found by verified employers across all nine provinces. Employers search live, freshness-weighted profiles by profession, province and skills. It is operated by Yetotec (Pty) Ltd and built POPIA-first.
faq.q2: Is Sebenza free for job seekers?
faq.a2: Yes. Creating a profile, being found, receiving invitations and accepting work are free for job seekers. Sebenza is not an employment agency: we never take a fee from your wages.
faq.a3: Verified employers search by profession, province and skills. Your public profile shows a redacted name and never shows your contact details, ID number or documents. An employer only reaches you through the platform, with your consent, and every contact reveal is recorded in an audit log you can review.
faq.q4: Do I need matric or a degree to join?
faq.a4: No. Sebenza is for every skill level, from general workers, artisans and drivers to graduates and professionals. Current students can register a student profile with their expected completion date. What matters is a truthful profile, not a specific qualification.
faq.q5: How is my personal information protected?
faq.a5: Sebenza is built around POPIA, South Africa's data protection law. You give specific consent for each way your information is used, and you can pause your visibility or withdraw consent at any time. Sensitive fields are encrypted, public pages are redacted, and every access to your personal information is logged.
faq.q6: What does “verified” mean on a profile?
faq.a6: A verification badge means the platform actually verified something, for example an employer confirming a work record. Every profile starts as “unverified” and we say so honestly; badges are never bought or assumed. Statistics count a hire only when it is confirmed through the platform.

meta.title: How Sebenza Works
meta.description: Sebenza is South Africa's POPIA-first national talent register. Job seekers build one free profile and get found; employers search live, honestly-verified talent; confirmed hiring becomes real labour-market intelligence.

hero.lead: Sebenza is a POPIA-first national talent register. Job seekers build one free profile and get found. Employers search live, freshness-weighted, honestly-verified talent. And the hiring that follows becomes real labour-market intelligence, not guesswork.
hero.microcopy: Free for job seekers, always. Works on any phone, in English, isiZulu, isiXhosa and Afrikaans.

problem.heading: Hiring in South Africa runs on noise
problem.item1: A hundred CVs in a WhatsApp group, and no way to tell who is real.
problem.item2: Databases where half the “available” people found work months ago.
problem.item3: Badges that say verified when nobody actually verified anything.
problem.item4: Job seekers paying to be seen, or losing money to fake recruiters.
problem.item5: Policy written from surveys that were old before they were published.
problem.closeA: South Africa does not have a talent shortage. It has a trustworthy-signal shortage.
problem.closeItalic: That is the problem Sebenza fixes.

who.heading: One register, three sides
who.seekersBody: Build one profile: your skills, experience, availability, and where you are. Get found by verified employers, get invited to real named roles, apply through public vacancy links, and control every bit of your information under POPIA. From general workers and artisans to graduates and professionals. Students too.
who.employersBody: Search by skill, place and availability, not by luck. See honest verification states and how fresh each profile is. Run vacancies: reverse-match candidates, invite them to named roles, share a public apply link on WhatsApp, and log the hire when it happens.
who.governmentBody: A privacy-floored, read-only analytics portal: where demand is, where supply is, why roles go unfilled, why learners stall, and how curriculum lines up with the market. Every figure is k-anonymised and aggregate. Never an identifiable person.

difference.heading: Honesty is the feature
difference.b1: A badge only says verified when something was actually verified. We never dress up self-reported data.
difference.b2: Every employment status carries a confirmation date. Stale profiles fall honestly down the list instead of wasting your calls.
difference.t3: A hire only counts when it's confirmed.
difference.b3: Our placement numbers are logged through the platform, never self-reported into a spreadsheet.
difference.b4: No ID numbers, no documents, no contact details in search. Contact is revealed only to verified employers, with consent, and every reveal is logged where the seeker can see it.
difference.b5: People are matched by where they are and what they can do. Nationality is shown, never a gate.

how.heading: One loop, from profile to policy
how.lead: The hiring is the product. The analytics fall out of it honestly.
how.s1b: Skills, experience, availability, place. Free, in four languages, on any phone.
how.s2b: Live filters by skill, province and availability, or reverse-matching against a specific vacancy.
how.s3b: The employer invites a seeker to a named role, or shares the vacancy's public Self Apply link anywhere, including WhatsApp, and seekers walk in themselves.
how.s4b: Verified employers only. Audited every time. The seeker sees who reached them.
how.s5b: Logged through the platform, so it counts once and counts true.
how.s6b: Confirmed hiring rolls up into k-anonymised analytics: demand, supply, shortages, outcomes. Live, not last year.

growth.heading: And for the seeker nobody has found yet
growth.lead: Sebenza doesn't just list you. It grows you, in one honest loop.
growth.g1t: Your Career compass reads real demand.
growth.g1b: It watches what employers near you actually search and hire for, compares that with your skills, and names the gap worth closing first.
growth.g2b: Free and low-cost South African routes (SETA learnerships, TVET programmes, recognised online courses) matched to that exact gap.
growth.g3t: The new skill lands on your profile.
growth.g3b: The moment you finish, it counts. No certificates to upload; your profile simply grows.
growth.g4b: Search results favour the skills employers want. Learning the right thing moves you up. The compass even shows the projected jump before you start.
growth.g5b: That's the whole point: you become findable for work you can actually do. And when it turns into a hire, it's confirmed on the platform, truthfully counted.

proof.heading: We’d rather show you the live numbers
proof.lead: These figures render straight from the register the moment you load this page. They are the same numbers our own dashboards run on. Freshness-weighted, never inflated.
proof.honest: Sebenza is young and we won’t pretend otherwise. We don’t invent five-star quotes: as real people and employers say real things, their words appear here with their names attached, and only with their consent.
proof.promise1: Free for job seekers. No fees, ever, and no paying to rank higher.
proof.promise2: POPIA-first from the first line of code: granular consent, field-level encryption, a permanent audit log, export and erasure built in.
proof.promise3: Honest badges, honest freshness, honest placement counts. The register would rather look smaller than lie.
proof.promise4: Built for the real South Africa: a low-end Android on 3G is our reference device, four launch languages, installable like an app.

why.heading: Why Sebenza, and not another job board
why.t1: It's a register, not a pinboard.
why.b1: Job boards list adverts. Sebenza maintains a living, freshness-weighted register of people, and roles come to them.
why.b2: Verification states, consent gates, audited reveals and redaction are enforced in code, on every read.
why.b3: Because hires are confirmed in-platform, the aggregate picture is real: live shortage signals, placement outcomes, curriculum-versus-demand. All k-anonymised.
why.b4: Employers pull with search and invitations; seekers walk in through public Self Apply links shared anywhere. One pipeline, honestly labelled.
why.b5: Seekers can pause visibility, block an employer, export everything, or erase themselves. Consent is per-purpose, never a blanket tick-box.

expiry.heading: Invite expiry
expiry.sub: How long an invite stays open if the seeker hasn’t responded. When it expires, both sides get a notification. Leave empty (or 0) to keep invites open indefinitely.
expiry.label: Days until invite expires
expiry.hint: 14 days is the typical default; 0 or empty = never expires.

positions.label: Open positions
positions.hint: How many people you plan to hire on this vacancy. Leave empty if there’s no fixed headcount; the match page then simply counts invites.

nudge.label: Send a gentle nudge after 7 days
nudge.sub: One reminder, only to seekers who haven’t responded yet. Capped at one nudge per invite: re-nudging is harassment.

selfApply.label: Let seekers apply via a public link
selfApply.sub: Generates a shareable page with the role, skills and description (never the salary band for visitors, never your pipeline). Applicants land in this vacancy’s pipeline as accepted candidates with a “Self-applied” chip. You review and shortlist them like invited seekers. Untick any time to close the link.

errors.expiry: Invite expiry must be empty or a positive number of days.
errors.nqf: Minimum NQF level must be empty, or between 1 and 10.
errors.provinceAny: Pick remote or hybrid before choosing Any province.

form.positionsErr: Open positions must be empty, or a whole number between 1 and 999.
form.minYearsErr: Minimum years of experience must be empty, or a whole number between 0 and 60.
form.skillsHelp: Pick the skills this vacancy needs. The matcher uses them to rank candidates. Can’t find one? Type it anyway and add it: our team reviews new skills and it becomes available platform-wide.

invite.modalLead: Each person will get a notification about “{vacancyTitle}.” They can accept, decline, or decline with a reason. Declining is free and never affects their visibility in search.
invite.rule1: Anyone without vacancy-invite consent is skipped silently; per-person reasons stay in the audit log.
invite.rule2: Already-invited candidates are skipped, so nobody is asked twice.
invite.rule3: Every invite sent is written to the audit log.
